recent.statement: The price of gold will increase by more than $20 within the next week
recent.evidence: No signal reports gold prices or any gold price movement, so there is no evidence the forecast event occurred within the closed window.

recent.statement: The VIX will increase by more than 10% within the next week
recent.evidence: No signal captured any VIX movement during the window, and a >10% VIX increase would certainly have been recorded if it had occurred.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a significant increase in ship transits within the next week.
recent.evidence: Strait of Hormuz recorded 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average, showing a decrease rather than a significant increase.
